company_context.offer_summary: Feature flags, release management, and AI config tooling for product and engineering teams.
company_context.target_audience_summary: Engineering, product, and platform teams managing releases and experiments.

extracted_facts.fact: The run collected a strong evidence base with good data quality and no dimensions without evidence.

visual_observations.observation: The public surface reads as a stable B2B platform rather than a promotional microsite.
The findings emphasize evidence binding problems more than surface ambiguity.

strategic_interpretation.interpretation: This is a strong non-web3 control case for checking whether the narrative layer overuses defensive caveats even when evidence is abundant.
The record is useful for studying evidence-binding discipline on a mature SaaS surface.

pattern_refs.reason: The report should stay bounded by the evidence ecosystem and not overstate conclusions.
The platform has strong surface claims, but the narrative layer still needs to avoid treating claims as proof.
The public platform and evidence signals are coherent enough to read as a mature system surface.

weak_inferences.inference: The mature SaaS surface may look more complete than the narrative evidence shows, so product maturity should not be inferred from surface polish alone.

human_review_requirements.requirement: Keep finding-level evidence binding explicit even when the overall run is high quality.
human_review_requirements.reason: The Phase 2 findings show that strong evidence can still produce repetitive caveats.

human_review_requirements.requirement: Do not treat the public surface as proof of performance.
human_review_requirements.reason: The record is a control case for narrative discipline, not a market validation artifact.
